race.description: Sctc Champion Trainer - Matthew Smith Hcp (Bm66)
race.comment: WINNING POINT (2) fitter after two runs back and gets map favours with the claim. Jumped quickly in trip second-up with a plugging sixth over 2200m at Grafton. Anywhere near her best could win this. FIERCENESS (4) deep into the campaign after he chipped away late when third in a solid rating race over this trip at Kembla Grange. Desperate for a fast tempo and not without each way claims. THAT A BOY (5) won well first-up, and has mixed his form in three runs since. Kept fresh again with winning rider going back aboard. Can take a hand in the finish. BRANNUM (6) thrown in the deep end again with a struggling ninth over 1600m at Randwick in Midway class. Can do much better.
